div.head: Duns 6.2
div.ab: Swa eac ælc ðe gewita oððe gewyrhta sy, ðær utlendisc man inlendiscan derie, geladie ðære midwiste be ðes orfes weorðe; ⁊ þæt sy cyreað; ⁊ se ðe hyne belecge, ofga his spræce mid foraðe.

Let every one that is cognisant or complicit where a stranger injures a native clear himself of such complicity [by an oath] to the value of the [lost] livestock, and [that oath] is to be a select oath [cyre-a‏‏þ]; and he who accuses him shall begin his case with a foreoath.

Sic omnis qui cooperaus uel conscius sit, ubi unlandiscus homo inlandiscum derie (id est extraneus indigenam noceat), adlegiet se super conscientia illa secundum precium captalis; et hoc iusiurando electo, quod dicitur cyreað. Et qui eum impetit, inducat causam suam mid foraðe (id est cum preiuratione).
